package domain

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// LessonReadAccess is the minimum audience allowed to read lesson content.
// A nil value on a hierarchy node means that the value is inherited from its
// nearest parent. If no node configures a value, the effective default is
// LessonReadAccessStudent.
type LessonReadAccess string

const (
	LessonReadAccessGuest      LessonReadAccess = "guest"
	LessonReadAccessStudent    LessonReadAccess = "student"
	LessonReadAccessStudentPro LessonReadAccess = "student_pro"
	LessonReadAccessDisabled   LessonReadAccess = "disabled"
)

// DefaultLessonReadAccess preserves the existing product rule: an
// authenticated student can read a lesson unless the hierarchy says
// otherwise.
const DefaultLessonReadAccess = LessonReadAccessStudent

func (a LessonReadAccess) Valid() bool {
	switch a {
	case LessonReadAccessGuest, LessonReadAccessStudent, LessonReadAccessStudentPro, LessonReadAccessDisabled:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// ParseLessonReadAccess validates a non-empty explicit hierarchy value.
func ParseLessonReadAccess(value string) (LessonReadAccess, error) {
	access := LessonReadAccess(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value)))
	if !access.Valid() {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid lesson_read_access %q: %w", value, ErrValidation)
	}
	return access, nil
}

func ValidateLessonReadAccess(access *LessonReadAccess) error {
	if access == nil || access.Valid() {
		return nil
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("invalid lesson_read_access %q: %w", *access, ErrValidation)
}

// LessonReadAccessResolution describes the effective policy chosen for a
// lesson and the hierarchy node that supplied it.
type LessonReadAccessResolution struct {
	Effective  LessonReadAccess
	SourceType string
	SourceID   string
}

// LessonReadAccessError is returned when the hierarchy is visible but the
// current audience may not read the lesson body.
type LessonReadAccessError struct {
	Code     string
	Required LessonReadAccess
}

func (e *LessonReadAccessError) Error() string {
	return e.Code
}

func (e *LessonReadAccessError) Unwrap() error {
	return ErrForbidden
}
